name: Review unsuccessful WhatsApp conversations in a daily Freshdesk triage ticket

const id=String($('Configure workflow').first().json.requesterId??'');if(!/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(id)||!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(id)))throw new Error('Choose an existing Freshdesk requester before enabling writes.');return $input.all();

parameters.content:
## WhatsApp support triage
One daily ticket links completed WhatsApp conversations whose Famulor analysis marks them unsuccessful. This is not a live message stream or a complete human-handoff queue. Preview is enabled; importing does not activate the schedule.

## Setup
Select a Famulor History-read HTTP Header Auth credential in the read node (calls:read scope). Select Freshdesk credentials and an existing requester ID. No customer resource is preselected. Keep previewOnly on for the first run.
[Famulor API setup](https://docs.famulor.io/automations/n8n)

## Review before writing
UTC previous day, up to 2,000 rows. Invalid or incomplete pages stop before writes. At most 50 references are included; omitted counts are stated. Analysis may arrive late. Bodies, names, numbers and summaries stay in Famulor.

## Destination test and repeats
Verify the exact export in a designated test Freshdesk area before enabling writes. Check requester, routing and notification rules. Re-running a window can duplicate the ticket; inspect Freshdesk before retrying an uncertain write.
